change: Eclipse Collections #786, preservation under colliding-key removal
deployment: Both original upstream source-built implementation and API JARs, implementation first.
assumptions: Distinct immutable keys have one hash code. A retained key-set view and null-key sentinel are observed after each call. No iteration-order requirement.

questions.observer: Check both returned flags, remaining mappings, retained key view, size and untouched null key after each of two removals.
questions.basis: An independent JDK HashMap removes the selected keys. For each insertion order the 127 subsets have 120 nonempty removals, 321 retained non-null mappings across trials and 127 retained nulls.
